name: The Polo Club
caption: The Southern region's own villainous tag team, managed by Kyle Polo.

tenures.source: The council's own 27 February 1998 Southern Championship Wrestling broadcast
tenures.note: Ambushed Southern States Champion Tommy Lane and his allies during a title match, breaking it up in a wild brawl.

name: The Electric Mayhem
caption: The Southern region's own tag team, installed as the first Mid-South Tag Team Champions when the region was renamed.

tenures.source: The council's own 4 March 1998 Southern Justice broadcast
tenures.note: Received the Southern States Tag Team Championship as it moved to Georgia, then were installed by the region's own commissioner as the first Mid-South Tag Team Champions.

identity.note: Name collision only: a same-named entity in another wing (electric-mayhem-scw-entity-a); no shared operator, chronology or storyline evidence in this wing's documents.

name: The Ottoman Empire
caption: A Southern region tag team from Istanbul, Turkey, who won by countout after a six-man brawl.

tenures.source: The council's own 31 January 1998 CWC Weekly Wrap Up broadcast
tenures.note: Won by countout over the Lane Brothers after A.J. Speed attacked Tommy Lane mid-match, recapped on the Weekly Wrap Up.

name: The Lane Brothers
caption: A Southern region tag team ambushed from behind by the Polo Club before their own match even began.

tenures.source: The council's own 31 January 1998 CWC Weekly Wrap Up broadcast
tenures.note: Ambushed by the Polo Club before losing to the Ottoman Empire by countout, recapped on the Weekly Wrap Up.

name: The Cowboys from Hell
caption: A debuting Texan tag team, accompanied by the valet Yellow Rose, who defeated the Grave Robbers in the Mid-Atlantic region.

tenures.source: The council's own late-January/early-February 1998 Mid-Atlantic showcase broadcasts
tenures.note: Debuted with a win over the Grave Robbers on a Mid-Atlantic region broadcast.

name: Cash and Krash
caption: A Mid-Atlantic region tag team who defeated the Boogie Woogie Express.

tenures.source: The council's own late-January/early-February 1998 Mid-Atlantic showcase broadcasts
tenures.note: Defeated the Boogie Woogie Express on a Mid-Atlantic region broadcast.

name: The Boogie Woogie Express
caption: A Mid-Atlantic region tag team defeated by Cash and Krash.

tenures.source: The council's own late-January/early-February 1998 Mid-Atlantic showcase broadcasts
tenures.note: Lost to Cash and Krash on a Mid-Atlantic region broadcast.

name: The Hearts of Darkness
caption: A Mid-Atlantic region stable that reformed after Rex Stone's battle royal win.

tenures.source: The council's own late-January/early-February 1998 Mid-Atlantic showcase broadcasts
tenures.note: Reformed on-air when Doom and Volcano came out to congratulate their stablemate Rex Stone on winning the vacant Mid-Atlantic Heavyweight Championship.

name: The Hot House
caption: The Southern region's own Southern States Tag Team Champions, managed by Lady Red.

tenures.source: The Georgia region's own In Memory of the Fallen supercard broadcast of 31 May 1998
tenures.note: Retained the Southern States Tag Team Championship against the New British Lions by double countout.

identity.note: A shared tag-team name only with an unrelated team recorded in a much larger, separately documented promotion; no roster, date or storyline overlap found.

name: The New British Lions
caption: Former Southern States Tag Team Champions representing the Technical Powers stable.

tenures.source: The Georgia region's own In Memory of the Fallen supercard broadcast of 31 May 1998
tenures.note: Challenged unsuccessfully for the Southern States Tag Team Championship, the match ending in a double countout.

name: The Supreme Fighting Empire
caption: A villainous Georgia region stable that helped win a tag title with outside interference and attacked the Southern States Champion after his own title defense.

tenures.source: The Georgia region's own In Memory of the Fallen supercard broadcast of 31 May 1998
tenures.note: Ian Walker maced John Weyrauch to help Jason Wallace and Ben Mullins win the Georgia State Tag Team Championship; Mark Dansera attacked Angel Reaper after the scaffold match main event, revealing himself as a fellow member.

name: The U.S. Bulldogs
caption: A Georgia region tag team representing the U.S. Inquisition stable, defeated for the vacant Georgia State Tag Team Championship.

tenures.source: The Georgia region's own In Memory of the Fallen supercard broadcast of 31 May 1998
tenures.note: Lost the vacant Georgia State Tag Team Championship tournament final after Ian Walker maced John Weyrauch.
